question: How to group 20 AC skeleton files?
reason: Matches test level (wire-contract vs artifact/property vs harness e2e) and keeps one file per AC with stable ids per Charter Part 16 action 8

question: How should skeletons fail: real assertions or false asserts?
chosen: Real wire/artifact-level assertions where a live server/artifact would be the only missing input (loud NOT IMPLEMENTED error from helpers); explicit expect(false,'NOT IMPLEMENTED...') with precise TODO-harness comments where Phase-2 harnesses (msw, Toxiproxy, Playwright fake-audio, gitleaks, axe) are required
reason: Real assertions stay honest and turn green exactly when the contract is met; false asserts document which harness each late-phase AC needs; rule 'no weakening to pass' preserved

question: AC10 tests initially passed because the fetcher stub threw and any throw counted as refusal - keep or fix?
chosen: Fix: refusedByFetcher() rethrows NOT IMPLEMENTED loudly so only a real fetcher refusal counts; both AC-10 tests now fail red as required
reason: A test passing for the wrong reason violates the Phase-0 receipt (all-red) and would mask a missing fetcher; never make a test pass by accident

question: Should AC-16 dummy pack fixture be committed with skeletons?
chosen: Yes - tests/fixtures/packs/xx-TEST/ data files only (pack/rules/translit/fixtures/README, status experimental)
reason: Fixture is test data not product logic; makes AC-16 harness-ready and doubles as the AC-06 experimental-tag example
